records.issue_text: Removing the documented `--category`/`-c` option breaks existing Disqus import commands and prevents topics from being imported into the requested category
records.rationale: The diff verifiably removes `method_option :category, aliases: '-c', desc: 'The category to post in'` and all category_id logic from lib/tasks/disqus.thor. Any existing import command using -c/--category will now fail (undeclared option) or lose category targeting, and the replacement `TopicEmbed.import_remote` path has no category parameter. Whether intentional or not, it is a real behavioral regression introduced by this diff.
records.stripped_text: Removing the documented `--category`/`-c` option breaks existing Disqus import commands and prevents topics from being imported into the requested category

records.issue_text: RSS-provided HTML is stored with `raw_html` and rendered via `raw`, bypassing sanitization and enabling stored XSS on the forum origin
records.rationale: TopicEmbed.import calls PostCreator with cook_method: raw_html, and Post#cook returns raw unsanitized when cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]; the embed view renders `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. RSS content from SiteSetting.feed_polling_url (i.content) is stored verbatim without sanitization, so a malicious feed entry yields stored XSS. The mechanism is fully verifiable in the diff.
records.stripped_text: RSS-provided HTML is stored with `raw_html` and rendered via `raw`, bypassing sanitization and enabling stored XSS on the forum origin

records.issue_text: The Disqus batch importer performs an unrescued network fetch for every thread, so one unavailable or malformed source URL aborts the remaining import
records.rationale: The diff replaces the previous PostCreator call in disqus.thor's import loop with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and import_remote in topic_embed.rb performs `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read, ...)` with no rescue. A failure on any single thread's URL raises inside the `parser.threads.each` loop, aborting the whole batch import — behavior introduced by this diff.
records.stripped_text: The Disqus batch importer performs an unrescued network fetch for every thread, so one unavailable or malformed source URL aborts the remaining import
